hero_title: Manage your building's packages without complications.
hero_subtitle: Adquete centralizes the safe reception, tracking, and delivery of parcels in modern residential buildings.
features_subtitle: Everything a concierge and a resident need for a digital coexistence.
f1_desc: Fast parcel entry with apartment number and automatic notification to the resident.
f2_desc: Complete record with exact dates of reception and pickup. Full traceability.
f3_desc: Maximum security through unique QR codes so only the authorized resident can pickup.
f4_desc: Real-time dashboard for concierges with package status and claims management.
